Although its gross and operating margins are relatively thin (6% and 4% respectively), characteristic of low-margin/high-volume industries, its adequate liquidity (current ratio of 1.30) and large scale support a solid investment-grade profile. This profile corresponds to a stable upper-medium investment grade rating.

DECISION: A-
